Let me look into this)}}.|audio = ContainmentWave12.ogg|[[Dispatcher]] on Wave 12 ([[Containment]])}} }} __TOC__ ==Description== The '''Rotting Terror''' was a high health enemy that spawns in [[The Nightmare Realm]] and [[Containment]] in the [[Hexscape Event]]. It had the highest health out of all enemies that appeared before it, though it was slower than most of them. It had 50% defense making it receive around 33% less damage from most sources. It also had [[Freeze Immunity]] and [[Stun Immunity]], making it harder to slow down. When it first spawned in [[The Nightmare Realm]], it was a [[Boss]] enemy, making it even harder to slow down. Additionally, on some waves, it could spawn as a [[Bloated]], [[Nimble]] or [[Aggro]] enemy. ==Appearance== The '''Rotting Terror''' was a large entity with brown skin. It had multiple neon red veins on its body. It did not have legs, instead having a brown spine. On its left arm, it had a rusty metal claw while on its right arm it has an exposed bone. On its head, it had neon red eyes and grey teeth. It had multiple spikes and tentacles which were the same color as its skin on its body. It wore a rusty red and grey helmet. ==Strategy== *Multiple early-game towers, like the [[Golden Crook Boss]], [[Cowboy]], [[Militant]] and [[Golden Soldier]] can be quite effective against this. **Stronger towers like the [[Engineer]], [[Ranger]], [[Minigunner]] or [[Gatling Gun]] can also be used here. *As the '''Rotting Terror''' has quite high defense, defense dropping towers like the [[Pyromancer]], [[DJ Booth]] or [[Trapper]] can against it. **Because of its [[Freeze Immunity]], freezing towers cannot be used to drop its defense. Additionally, all other forms of defense dropping are currently bugged and do not work. *The '''Rotting Terror''' is quite fast for its health, making stalling towers useful. However, because of its immunities, it cannot be knocked back, chilled or frozen, while stuns only slow it down. **Additionally, when it first spawns in [[The Nightmare Realm]], it is as a [[Boss]] enemy, meaning that the stalling options are further limited to just stun slowdown. **As it is a large enemy, it will be stalled for a shorter amount of time compared to average-sized enemies. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Animations}} RottingTerrorWalk.gif|Walking animation (25 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) RottingTerrorDeath.gif|Death animation (25 October 2024 – 20 November 2024) {{GalleryHeader|Trailers}} The Hexscape Trailer (HALLOWEEN) - Tower Defense Simulator|'''Rotting Terror''' in the game trailer. }} ==Trivia== *The '''Rotting Terror's''' appearance and animations are re-used from the [[Failed Experiment]], with most noticeably having the same bone exposure on its right arm, as well as skeletal spine shape trailing out of its torso. ==Update History== *'''25 October 2024''' - [[v1.38.0]] **'''Rotting Terror''' added. **{{Bug}} Poison and electric defense dropping does not decrease '''Rotting Terror's''' defense. *'''30 October 2024''' - [[v1.39.0]] **'''Rotting Terror''' now appears in [[Containment]]. *'''6 November 2024''' - [[v1.40.0]] **'''Rotting Terror''' can no longer have its defense dropped while a [[Boss]] enemy. **{{Bugfix}} Poison and electric defense dropping towers now can drop its defense, though the [[Jester]] still cannot drop it. *'''20 November 2024''' - [[v1.42.0]] **'''Rotting Terror''' removed. ==Notes== {{TheNightmareRealm|[[Hex Mimic]]|Wave 7 (Easy)|hardt1 = [[Hex Mimic]] & [[Hex Corpse]]|hardw1 = Wave 6 (Hard)|Rotting Terror & [[Hex Corpse]]|Wave 8 (Easy)|hardt2 = Rotting Terror|hardw2 = Wave 8 (Hard)|[[Blight Walker]]|Wave 10}} {{Containment|[[Blight Walker]]|Wave 11|Rotting Terror|Wave 12|[[Cursed Horror]]|Wave 13}} {{ZombieNavBox}}
